EFO.definition: An infiltrating malignant tumor characterized by the presence of atypical cells with myoepithelial differentiation. Representative examples include malignant breast myoepithelioma and salivary gland myoepithelial carcinoma.
EFO.name: malignant myoepithelioma

EFO.definition: A lung carcinoma arising within the bronchi or bronchial tubes. It is characterized by the presence of myoepithelial cells, spindle cells, clear cells, and duct-forming epithelial cells. Surgical resection may be curative.
EFO.name: lung epithelial-myoepithelial carcinoma

EFO.definition: A malignant neoplasm which occurs mostly in the major salivary glands (most frequently in the parotid gland), but also in the minor salivary glands of the oral mucosa and the tracheobronchial tree. It is characterized by the presence of ductal structures which are lined by an inner layer of cuboidal epithelial-type cells and an outer layer of myoepithelial cells with clear or eosinophilic cytoplas
EFO.name: epithelial-myoepithelial carcinoma

EFO.definition: A carcinoma that arises from the salivary glands, most often the parotid gland. It presents as a slow growing and painless mass. It is characterized by the presence of duct-like structures lined by two layers of cells, an inner layer composed of epithelial-type cells and an outer layer composed of clear, myoepithelial-type cells.
EFO.name: salivary gland epithelial myoepithelial carcinoma

EFO.definition: An invasive malignant tumor that arises from the breast. It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped myoepithelial cells. Mitoses are present. Rarely, local recurrences and distant metastases have been reported.
EFO.name: malignant breast myoepithelioma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: Derived from epithelial cells and destined to become a part of the muscular system; having the characteristics of both muscle and epithelium.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Myoepithelial

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A contractile cell found between the secretory cells and basement membrane of exocrine glands. Each myoepithelial cell has long cytoplasmic processes that wrap around a secretory unit. The contraction of the myoepithelial processes forces the secretory product from the secretory unit into its duct.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Myoepithelial Cell

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A benign or malignant tumor characterized by the presence of cells that show myoepithelial differentiation. Based on its morphologic features, it is classified as benign or malignant. A representative example of benign myoepithelioma is benign salivary gland myoepithelioma. Representative examples of malignant myoepithelioma or myoepithelial carcinoma are malignant breast myoepithelioma and salivary gland myoepithelial carcinoma.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Myoepithelial Tumor

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A very rare, benign or malignant lung tumor with myoepithelial differentiation.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Lung Myoepithelial Tumor

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A very rare malignant lung tumor with myoepithelial differentiation.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Lung Myoepithelial Carcinoma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A myoepithelial tumor that occurs during childhood.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Childhood Myoepithelial Tumor
synonyms: Childhood Myoepithelial Tumor of Soft Tissue
Pediatric Myoepithelial Tumor of Soft Tissue

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A benign or malignant tumor that arises from the breast and originates from or is composed of myoepithelial cells.  Representative examples include adenomyoepithelioma, myoepitheliosis, and malignant myoepithelioma.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Breast Myoepithelial Tumor

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A malignant neoplasm which occurs mostly in the major salivary glands (most frequently in the parotid gland), but also in the minor salivary glands of the oral mucosa and the tracheobronchial tree. It is characterized by the presence of ductal structures which are lined by an inner layer of cuboidal epithelial-type cells and an outer layer of myoepithelial cells with clear or eosinophilic cytoplasm.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Epithelial-Myoepithelial Carcinoma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A carcinoma that arises from the lacrimal gland and is characterized by the presence of a malignant cellular infiltrate exhibiting myoepithelial differentiation.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Lacrimal Gland Myoepithelial Carcinoma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A locally aggressive carcinoma that arises from the salivary glands, predominantly the parotid gland. It is characterized by the presence of a malignant cellular infiltrate exhibiting myoepithelial differentiation. Patients usually present with a painless mass.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Salivary Gland Myoepithelial Carcinoma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A benign or malignant tumor that arises from the salivary glands.  It is characterized by the presence of neoplastic cells with myoepithelial differentiation.  This category includes benign myoepithelioma and myoepithelial carcinoma.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Salivary Gland Myoepithelial Tumor

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A lung carcinoma arising within the bronchi or bronchial tubes.  It is characterized by the presence of myoepithelial cells, spindle cells, clear cells, and duct-forming epithelial cells.  Surgical resection may be curative.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Lung Epithelial-Myoepithelial Carcinoma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A rare slow-growing carcinoma that arises from the lacrimal gland and is characterized by the presence of duct-like structures lined by two layers of cells; an inner layer composed of epithelial-type cells and an outer layer composed of clear, myoepithelial-type cells.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Lacrimal Gland Epithelial-Myoepithelial Carcinoma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A carcinoma that arises from the salivary glands, most often the parotid gland.  It presents as a slow growing and painless mass.  It is characterized by the presence of duct-like structures lined by two layers of cells, an inner layer composed of epithelial-type cells and an outer layer composed of clear, myoepithelial-type cells.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Salivary Gland Epithelial-Myoepithelial Carcinoma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: An infiltrating malignant tumor characterized by the presence of atypical cells with myoepithelial differentiation. Representative examples include malignant breast myoepithelioma and salivary gland myoepithelial carcinoma.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Malignant Myoepithelioma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: An invasive malignant tumor that arises from the breast.  It is characterized by the presence of spindle-shaped myoepithelial cells.  Mitoses are present.  Rarely, local recurrences and distant metastases have been reported.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Breast Malignant Myoepithelioma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: The reemergence of a malignant myoepithelioma after a period of remission.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Recurrent Malignant Myoepithelioma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A malignant myoepithelioma that does not respond to treatment.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Refractory Malignant Myoepithelioma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A benign neoplasm characterized by the proliferation of cells with myoepithelial differentiation around spaces which are lined by epithelial cells.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Experimental Organism Benign Adenomyoepithelioma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A very rare benign lung tumor with myoepithelial differentiation.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Lung Myoepithelioma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A benign skin neoplasm composed exclusively of myoepithelial cells.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Skin Myoepithelioma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A benign neoplasm with myoepithelial differentiation arising from the lacrimal gland. It lacks an infiltrative growth pattern and does not metastasize.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Lacrimal Gland Myoepithelioma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A multifocal neoplastic process characterized by the proliferation of spindle to cuboidal myoepithelial cells within and/or around small breast ducts.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Breast Myoepitheliosis

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A neoplastic process characterized by the proliferation of spindle to cuboidal myoepithelial cells in and around small breast ducts exhibiting cytologic atypia and mitotic activity.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Breast Atypical Myoepitheliosis

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A neoplastic process characterized by the proliferation of spindle to cuboidal myoepithelial cells within small breast ducts.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Breast Intraductal Myoepitheliosis

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A neoplastic process characterized by the proliferation of spindle to cuboidal myoepithelial cells around small breast ducts.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Breast Periductal Myoepitheliosis

NCI Thesaurus.definition: An adenomyoepithelioma of the breast in which the epithelial, myoepithelial, or both components have undergone malignant transformation.  Such cases may follow an aggressive clinical course, including recurrences and local and distant metastases.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Malignant Breast Adenomyoepithelioma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A benign, nodular tumor that arises from the breast parenchyma.  It is characterized by the proliferation of myoepithelial cells around spaces that are lined by epithelial cells.  Occasionally, adenomyoepitheliomas may undergo malignant transformation.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Benign Breast Adenomyoepithelioma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A rare benign tumor composed of sheets and islands of spindle, plasmacytoid, epithelioid, and clear cells that exhibit myoepithelial but not ductal differentiation. The average age of patients has been reported as 44 years. Clinically, these tumors present as asymptomatic masses. Discrimination between myoepithelioma and myoepithelial carcinoma is based primarily on the infiltrative growth of the latter.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Salivary Gland Myoepithelioma
synonyms: Benign Myoepithelioma of the Salivary Gland

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A usually benign tumor arising from the breast. It is characterized by the proliferation of cells with myoepithelial differentiation around spaces which are lined by epithelial cells. Rarely, the epithelial and/or myoepithelial cells may undergo malignant transformation. Cases with malignant transformation may follow an aggressive clinical course, including recurrences and local and distant metastases.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Breast Adenomyoepithelioma

NCI Thesaurus.definition: A tumor with myoepithelial differentiation that lacks an infiltrative growth pattern and does not metastasize.
NCI Thesaurus.name: Benign Myoepithelioma
